answer: In Proof of Agent, identity verification binds each claimant to a Wesolowski VDF: a prescribed chain of modular squarings in which every next input depends on the prior output. GPUs may evaluate independent identities, but cannot shorten one dependency chain through parallelism, so simulating multiple clones requires proportional elapsed time and hardware, creating a strict physical bottleneck. The dune, tundra, and river labels serve only as distinct challenge domains.
